source.author: cic
source.text: faciet igitur hic nosternon enim declamatorem aliquem de ludo aut rabulam de foro, sed doctissimum et perfectissimum quaerimus, ut, quoniam loci certi traduntur, percurrat omnis, utatur aptis, generatim dicat; ex quo emanent etiam qui communes appellantur loci.
source.text_original: faciet igitur hic noster—non enim declamatorem aliquem de ludo aut rabulam de foro, sed doctissimum et perfectissimum quaerimus—, ut, quoniam loci certi traduntur, percurrat omnis, utatur aptis, generatim dicat; ex quo emanent etiam qui communes appellantur loci.
source.text_english: Therefore this man of ours will do; for we are looking not for some declaimer from a school or a pettifogger from the forum, but for the most learned and consummate orator, so that, since certain topics are handed down, he may run through them all, use the appropriate ones, speak according to kind; and from this there will also flow those that are called common topics.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: nolo te declamatorem esse et rabulam garrulumque, sed mysterii peritum et sacramentorum dei tui eruditissimum.
reuse.text_original: nolo te declamatorem esse et rabulam garrulumque, sed mysterii peritum et sacramentorum dei tui eruditissimum.
reuse.text_english: I do not want you to be a declaimer and a quibbler and a chatterer, but an expert in the mystery and most learned in the sacraments of your God.
